pages.text: The cities are not unguarded. The Echo Sentinel is a floating construct that still keeps watch — it charges and fires a light-pulse beam. It haunts the $(l:undercrown_caverns)Undercrown$(/l) and the buried vaults.
Defeat one for resonance core fragments, luminite, memory crystal shards, and rarely a Lumen Relay — the parts you need to rebuild the Lumenwrights' $(l:resonance_network)Resonance Network$(/l).
